notes: priors are offline shared models fitted on the TRAIN half only; they are not counted in message bytes
every message byte count = varint length field + range-coded payload (agent mask, float32 poses, body, residual)
sensor height z = W.FLOOR_T + W.SENSOR_HEIGHT is a protocol constant (asserted equal to every generator pose)
decoding = W.observe (memoised exactly, see module docstring) from the decoded float32 poses, joined with the shared map
6.5 KB = 6,500 B; bits_* columns are ideal code lengths per component, bits_coder = 8 x payload bytes - their sum
SYNC tier u re-sends the full exclude-back message every round (rollout_max schedule); an empty tier-c message costs its 1-byte length field

W3 uses GENERATOR KNOWLEDGE: its plan split uses BAND = z 23-24 and LINTEL_MAX_FREE = 21 (inherited from A03 p8: above every furniture top of the generator, below the lowest ceiling; door tops 2.1-2.25 m), and its box language is isomorphic to the generator's axis-aligned boxes. This affects bytes only, never exactness (paint never meets an observed free voxel). Reviewer sensitivity (claude_handoff/analysis_20261027/g4/review_e0, 2 VAL houses, 3+3 TRAIN prior; reference only, NOT arms): as run own 195/194.5 B, CAV 288.5/288 B, CD-c 4,537/4,452 B per house; noplan (no plan, boxes only) own 188.5/182.5, CAV 303.5/306, CD-c 4,764/4,667; generic (BAND = full height, no lintel limit) own 221/222.5, CAV 334/331.5, CD-c 5,364/5,182 (priors A/B)
the session grid cell = (L/128, L/128, 0.1) m (L = house-fitted chart) is a public session constant and is not counted in message bytes (at most ~1 B per house)
prior size (offline, public, not counted): see priors[half].npz_bytes / table_entries

verdict.verdict_line: INCOMPLETE (provisional reading FAIL_ii) | literal D8-36 reading (CAV, CD-c): FAIL_ii, best arm W1 | A03-definition reading (uncond converged message, CD-u per house): FAIL | if the arm were fixed to W3: literal FAIL_ii, A03-definition FAIL
incomplete_reasons: panel fresh has no evaluated house (0 skipped)
verdict.best_arm_rule: lowest sum over the 4 panel x prior cells of the median per-house collect-distribute (tier c) bytes

definitions.own: median K0 own-map message bytes (tier u: decoded from the own code alone)
definitions.cav: LITERAL: median over directed edges of m(u->v) conditioned on the cavity m(v->u) (CAV rows; a rate readout)
definitions.house: LITERAL: median over houses of the total bytes of one collect-distribute fusion, tier c (every directed edge once)
definitions.uncond_msg_median: A03 definition (report): median CD-u message = unconditioned sender-side union (A03 p9 edge), vs 420 B
definitions.house_cd_uncond_median: A03 definition (report): median per-house CD-u total (A03 6.1 KB measurement), vs 6,500 B
definitions.cd_distribute_cond_median: report: median of the realisable conditioned messages (CD tier c, distribute phase)
definitions.halves: |A - B| / min(A, B) of each of the three literal medians, per panel, for the best arm

verdict.reading: PASS -> the S0-class exact code is locked as the lossless reference line OF THIS SYNTHETIC WORLD (W3's split constants and box language are isomorphic to the generator; generalisation to other worlds is not covered by this criterion); FAIL_ii -> ~200 B was a small-panel artefact, raise the byte targets before any GPU; INCONCLUSIVE -> a bug (some decode was not voxel-exact), fix before reading any number; INCOMPLETE -> not a verdict (smoke / partial / fault-injected run)
